name: Wobani
description: Wobani was a temperate planet partially hidden by a swirling dust cloud, located in the Wobani system, in the Bryx sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim. During the Imperial Era, the planet was used by the Galactic Empire as a site for labor and prison camps.
